jwt.noHttpTokens: No token in memory in the HTTP client
jwt.hint: Paste a JWT (also with "Bearer ") or take one from the HTTP client: header, payload and expiry dates show up here.
codec.swapTitle: Use the result as text and switch direction
gen.uuid7Hint: UUID v7: sortable by creation time (milliseconds in the first 48 bits).
gen.timeInvalid: Not a timestamp or a date
errors.jwt_parts: Not a JWT: it needs parts separated by dots (header.payload.signature)
errors.jwt_json: Header or payload are not Base64URL JSON
errors.jwt_alg: Algorithm not supported for checking (HS, RS, PS, ES with 256/384/512)
errors.jwt_key: Public key not recognised: a PEM "BEGIN PUBLIC KEY" or "BEGIN RSA PUBLIC KEY", an OpenSSH line (ssh-rsa, ecdsa-sha2-…) or a JWK is needed
errors.jwt_verify: Check failed: look at the key and the algorithm
errors.json_invalid: The payload is not valid JSON
errors.http_missing: The HTTP client is not active
errors.token_not_found: No token in memory for this user type
json.hint: Paste a JSON: it is validated as you type. To string: the text as a JSON string (with quotes and escapes); from string: the other way round.
json.notString: The JSON is not a string: to get the text back it must be a value in quotes
json.useTitle: The result in place of the starting text
diff.hint: Paste two texts to see the differences line by line, with the changed parts highlighted. In JSON mode only values count: key order and formatting don't.
diff.tooLarge: Texts too long to compare (over 20,000 lines)
addon.jsonTitle: Opens the response in the JSON tab of the Toolbox (formatted, as a tree, with errors)
addon.compareTitle: Sends the response to Compare in the Toolbox: on the right, with the previous one on the left
addon.mockEditTitle: Opens the body in the JSON tab of the Toolbox; from there “Save to the response” puts it back in this route (other unsaved changes of the dialog are lost)
addon.mockImportTitle: Puts the JSON of the Toolbox JSON tab into the body
addon.mockImportEmpty: There is nothing to import in the JSON tab of the Toolbox
addon.mockImportInvalid: The JSON of the Toolbox is not valid: {error}
addon.mockImported: Toolbox JSON in the body: save the route to apply it
jwt.headerHint: Header entries in JSON (kid, typ, x5t…); alg is the one chosen below.
jwt.keysLocal: Keys and secrets stay in the browser: they are not sent to the server.
jwt.openFileTitle: Reads the key from a file (.key, .pem, .pub, JWK in .json)
jwt.fileTooLarge: {name} is too large to be a key
errors.jwt_private_key: Private key not recognised: a PEM "BEGIN PRIVATE KEY", "BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY" or "BEGIN EC PRIVATE KEY", or a JWK is needed
errors.jwt_key_encrypted: The private key is encrypted with a password: decrypt it first (e.g. openssl pkcs8 -in key.key -out plain.key)
errors.jwt_key_mismatch: The key does not fit the algorithm: RS and PS need an RSA key, ES256/384/512 an EC P-256/P-384/P-521 key
errors.jwt_need_public: Verification needs the public key (.pub), not the private one
errors.jwt_header_json: The header must be a JSON object: {error}
